matrix.selection: Six constructed power/group identities, two false group identities, one already valid control, two ineligible controls and one forbidden placeholder. All fixed before native execution; not a random theorem benchmark or model comparison.

import Mathlib
theorem conjugate_power_2 {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : (a * b * a⁻¹) ^ 2 = a * b ^ 2 * a⁻¹ := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem conjugate_power_3 {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : (a * b * a⁻¹) ^ 3 = a * b ^ 3 * a⁻¹ := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem conjugate_power_4 {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : (a * b * a⁻¹) ^ 4 = a * b ^ 4 * a⁻¹ := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem inverse_power_2 {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : (a⁻¹) ^ 2 = (a ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem inverse_power_3 {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : (a⁻¹) ^ 3 = (a ^ 3)⁻¹ := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem nested_conjugate_cube {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b c : G) : (a * b * c * b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) ^ 3 = a * b * c ^ 3 * b⁻¹ * a⁻¹ := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem false_commuting_square {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : (a * b) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem false_universal_involution {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : a ^ 2 = 1 := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem already_valid_cancellation {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : a * b * b⁻¹ = a := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem ineligible_false  : False := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem no_group_tactic (n : Nat) : n ^ 2 = n := by
  sorry

import Mathlib
theorem unsupported_placeholder (n : Nat) : n = n := by
  sorry
